featured_reviews.name: Aahana Jha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I honestly don’t even know where to start… 🥹
Nritya Shakti has given me so much more than just dance. It has given me confidence, growth, memories, discipline, happiness,  filled with the most beautiful people. Forever grateful to Shakti Ma’am and every single faculty member who believed in me, pushed me, inspired me, and helped me become the person and dancer I am today. ✨

ITP has truly been one of the best journeys of my life. It didn’t just teach me choreography, it shaped me into a versatile dancer and helped me discover parts of myself I never knew existed. From learning different styles to performing fearlessly, every class, every correction, every rehearsal, and every moment became a step toward becoming stronger and more confident.

Dance slowly became more than just a passion for me… it became my safe space, my happiness, and my way of expressing emotions I could never put into words. And ITP played such a huge role in deepening that love for dance. ❤️

Looking back at this journey fills my heart with so much gratitude and emotion. The memories, the people, the lessons, the laughter, the struggles, and the growth! everything will stay with me forever. So thankful that I found ITP and got to experience something this special. Truly one of the biggest blessings of my life.  Forever grateful.
